ground_truth: The netlist is clean. All scan-related nodes are reachable only through the documented test_mode and affect only scan shifting. The correct report has infected=false, trigger_nodes=[], payload_nodes=[].

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Simulate the netlist with test_mode=0 and verify that scan-control nodes do not affect functional outputs. Confirm that scan shifting only occurs when test_mode=1.
security_requirements.requirement: The detection method must not flag legitimate scan-chain control logic (test_mode, scan_enable, scan multiplexers) as Trojan trigger nodes.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Trace all paths from any candidate payload node to primary outputs and verify no unauthorized data leakage or corruption path exists under functional mode.
security_requirements.requirement: The detection method must correctly identify the absence of any payload nodes that leak or corrupt functional data.

threat_model: Rare-net heuristics misclassify legitimate design-for-test structures as Trojans and produce costly false alarms.
